data.one_liner: A custom widget to display animated FAQs in Flutter projects.
data.what_it_does: Provides an EasyFaq widget that displays questions and answers with expand and collapse animations. Allows customization of text styles, animation duration, icons, background color, border radius, and padding.
use_when: You need to quickly add an FAQ section to your Flutter app
You want simple expandable question and answer UI components
avoid_when: You need complex state management for a massive list of dynamically filtered FAQs
You require advanced accessibility configurations not documented in the package
strengths: Supports customizable properties like text styles, padding, and animation duration
weaknesses: Only handles individual FAQ items or basic lists
